Subject: Clarify BYO-KMS / HSM and audit log requirements — follow-up

Hi Alice — thanks for the call earlier. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so our infra/eng team can scope the BYO-KMS / logging work before the tech deep-dive next week. I copied Karthik and Laura for pricing/PO and product context.

Recap (what I heard):
- Finera needs customer-managed keys for production inference in us-east-1 (BYOK).
- HSM-backed keys are preferred for keys with PHI/PII; you mentioned CloudHSM as an option.
- Audit log retention: 7+ years for security events; access logs for analytics/forensics.
- Data retention for PII: 5 years with ability to trigger deletions per legal requests.

Clarifying questions (can you confirm / add):
1) Key hosting: do you require keys to be in your AWS account (AWS KMS with CloudHSM-backed keys) or would an HSM in your datacenter (on-prem HSM) also be acceptable?
2) Minimum crypto requirements: any specific algorithms/certifications (e.g., FIPS 140-2 Level 3) we should plan for?
3) Logging surface: which events are must-have in logs (key usage, key creation/deletion, token issuance, model input hashing, admin actions)? Is there a standard schema you will share?
4) Rotation/rotation window: do you have a maximum key rotation period (e.g., 90 days)?
5) Legal/compliance: who from Legal should we expect to loop in for a BAA / DPA review?

Next steps suggested from our side:
- Small technical sync (30 min) with our infra lead and your security engineer to run through BYOK flow and log telemetry examples.
- I’ll share a one-pager on Redwood BYOK and the audit events we currently surface.
- Karthik will follow up on contract/PO timeline once the scope is clear.

Would Thursday or Friday next week work for the tech sync? I can do 10–12 PT on either day.

Thanks — Stephanie

Hi Stephanie — thanks for the summary, that captures it well. Quick answers below and I've attached our security spreadsheet and a KMS decision matrix for reference.

Answers:
1) Key hosting: We strongly prefer keys in our AWS account (us-east-1) using AWS KMS backed by CloudHSM. On-prem HSM is acceptable for a later phase but not for initial production.
2) Crypto/certs: FIPS 140-2 Level 2 is the minimum; Level 3 is preferred for HSMs that hold PHI. We use AES-256 for data keys and RSA-4096 for asymmetric ops.
3) Logs: must include key usage (who/which instance/keyID), key policy changes, creation/deletion, and admin API calls. We also need request-level metadata (timestamp, request-id, model id, truncated input hash). A CSV mapping is in the attached spreadsheet.
4) Rotation: 90 days max for data keys; master keys can be 1 year but must support key rotation events in logging.
5) Legal: loop in legal@finera.health and our outside counsel (they will send redlines for DPA/BAA).

Attachments: security-requirements.xlsx, finera-kms-matrix.pdf

We can do a tech sync on Friday 22 Nov, 10:30 PT. Daniel (cc) will join from our infra/security team.

Best,
Alice
Alice Zhang
Director, Security & Compliance
Finera Health

Thanks Alice — this is helpful. Couple quick clarifiers from the engineering/product side:

- We support AWS KMS BYOK with a cross-account key policy today; CloudHSM-backed keys are supported when the customer provisions the key material in their AWS account. For on-prem HSM we offer an MPO (managed private option) but it requires a longer integration window.
- Can you confirm whether you need server-side encryption of cached model artifacts at rest (we typically encrypt cached weights with the same data-key material, but we can also segregate with a different key per customer if required).
- For logging: we can emit an audit stream with the events you listed. We need to confirm retention SLA and whether logs must be pushed to your S3 bucket vs. retained in Redwood for forwarding. Pushing to your S3 (cross-account write) is supported.

Action items we’ll take before the tech call:
1) Product will prepare a short note (1–2 pages) showing BYOK flows (cross-account KMS, key rotation, HSM-backed creation) and the audit events we can emit.
2) Security will draft an S3 log-forwarding sample (pre-signed PUT and inventory manifest).
3) Sales/Legal (Laura) will prepare an initial timeline and PO template for Finera.

Stephanie — let’s lock the 22 Nov slot. Alice — can you confirm the exact attendees for the tech call so we can include the right engineers?

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Product Manager, Security
Redwood Inference
